protocols.title: Teriparatide (10 mg) Dosage Protocol — source reference
protocols.purpose: Individual-page schedule and handling details, transcribed as a research/educational reference
protocols.evidenceNotes: Secondary commercial source; these are the page's statements, not independently verified clinical guidance. Prescription PTH(1–34) medicine is dosed in micrograms, not milligrams; the page frames the research vial as reference only and not a dosing recommendation. Follow approved product labeling and specialist care; do not translate a research vial into a regimen.

schedule.description: Approved pre-filled pen dose. Trial also studied 40 mcg/day, with more adverse effects; not a research-vial schedule.

regimen.notes: This source explicitly says the page provides no dose for administration from the research vial. 20 mcg/day is approved-product label context only; the vial's concentration math is not an administration recommendation.
